notes: PARENTAGE UNSUPPORTED AND GEOGRAPHICALLY IMPLAUSIBLE (research 2026-07-03): this record is given as father of 'Isobel Grant,' wife of John Murray of Ewes (I182381538417) — but if her surname really was Grant (itself unconfirmed; WikiTree's parallel record calls her only 'Isobel Unknown'), her father would be expected to carry the surname Grant, not Murray. No source was found connecting an Alexander Murray of Alves, Moray (on the Moray Firth, over 100 miles from Eskdale/Dumfriesshire) to an Isobel Grant who married into the Eskdale Murray family. This record looks like a stray/duplicate entry pulled in from an unrelated Murray line and mis-attached as a parent here.
